race.comment: DASHING RED STAR (1) made a sound debut at Gawler, finishing third after being slow to begin, and that exposed run gives him a strong platform second-up. The move to 1300m is new, but he was solid enough at 1100m and has the winning rider back. Among the leading chances. UPSANDDOWNS (8) has had more chances but brings the best recent form, with his Gawler fourth better than it reads after interference and being held up late. Ready to find winning form. POCKET PYRO (12) was well fancied on debut at this track, picked up strongly for third and draws to get every chance, though she is also untried at the trip. Worth consideration here. REGAL TIME (7) is a seasoned maiden, but her Mildura third two back and genuine excuses at Swan Hill keep her in the each-way mix.
